description: Filter — low-pass, high-pass, band-pass or band-reject, switched

params.text: Cutoff, or centre frequency in the band modes
Bipolar, attenuverted, added to the cutoff
Exponential, attenuated by the FM knob
Resonance in the pass modes, bandwidth in the band modes; CV 0-10V
LP passes what is below the cutoff, HP what is above it, BP a band around the centre frequency, BR everything but that band
From 1 to 12 poles, continuously; CV at SLP

inputs.text: Bipolar, attenuverted, added to the cutoff
Exponential, attenuated by the FM knob
Read as a pitch; set the knob to 0Hz for accurate key tracking
The signal into the filter; the channels patched here set the module's polyphony
Resonance in the pass modes, bandwidth in the band modes; CV 0-10V
From 1 to 12 poles, continuously; CV at SLP

outputs.text: The filtered signal, with a fixed two-pole highpass at 80Hz on it

menu: Bandwidth mode — Pitched puts the band edges an equal pitch either side of the centre, to a maximum of two octaves; Linear puts them an equal number of hertz either side, to a maximum of 2000Hz
